critical_code_review_comments: holiday_manager.py: Clean implementation with 407 lines - well within file size guidelines
MongoDB schema: date (YYYY-MM-DD), name, year (int), source, updated_at - all fields properly indexed
Background task: _holiday_update_loop runs daily at 02:00 IST, auto-fetches during March 25-31 window
Dual-source fetching: NSE API primary, Zerodha fallback - robust external data retrieval
In-memory cache: _holidays_set provides fast O(1) lookups for trading day calculations
get_remaining_trading_days: Correctly uses both holiday set AND weekday check (d.weekday() < 5)
2026-08-15 (Independence Day on Saturday): NSE API includes it, but trading day calc filters weekends separately - correct behavior
Admin endpoints properly protected with get_owner_user dependency
seed_data_creation: None - holiday_manager.py seeds defaults automatically on first run
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 18 tested NSE holiday management feature. All 21 tests pass. Key findings: (1) GET /api/admin/nse-holidays returns holidays from MongoDB with correct schema. (2) POST /api/admin/nse-holidays/refresh?year=2026 triggers live NSE API fetch - successfully fetched 20 holidays. (3) Background task starts on app startup (confirmed in logs). (4) Auto-fetch window is March 25-31 (one week before April 1st). (5) Old incorrect dates (2026-02-19, 2026-03-25, 2026-10-23) are NOT in holiday list. (6) 2026-08-15 (Saturday) is in NSE API response but weekends are filtered separately in get_remaining_trading_days(). (7) Auth protection works - 401 returned without valid token.
